Procedures to be Carried Out
Calibration of STKJ for the TX signal
Insert the thermometer in the back of the STKJ card for 15 minutes, then remove the front of the Thermocouple module switches, and switch OFF all the switches | 1.
Connect an mV source from C4,5 on the calibrator to in, +in on the TX-A channel, then connect a digital voltmeter (DVM) to measure this mV, and connect another DVM at Acom & Out for the TX-A channel to measure the output of the STKJ card | 2.
Calculate the true mV value from the following relation: mV = 0.02248 (TAF - 32) - (recorded) mV, correction factor @ 1.02. Actual mV = TX - Correction Factor | 3.
Achieve the following table: | 
Manufacture Setting | Before Adjust. | After Adjust. | Adjustment
C | F | Input m.V | Out volt from STKJ
371 | 700 | 15.18 1.02 | 3.50 + 0.02 |  |  | 
510 | 950 | 21.07 1.02 | 4.75 + 0.02 |  |  | Factory Calibrated
649 | 1200 | 26.98 1.02 | 6.6 + 0.02 |  |  | 
Repeat steps (2–3) to calibrate the Temp. Meter | 4.
Repeat steps (2–3) to calibrate the STKJ cards for the (OTA & OTB) signals | 5.
Calibration of Pressure Compressor Discharge (PCD)
Disconnect the air signal line and connect it to an external air line (0–150 PSI) | 1. | 
Measure the output of 96CD according to the following table: | 2. | 
Manufacture Setting | Before Adjust. | After Adjust. | Adjustment
PSI | Kg / Cm2 | Out Volt from 96CD
0 | 0 | 0 + 0.005 |  |  | Zero
87.5 | 6.152 | 2.5 + 0.005 |  |  | --
175.5 | 12.304 | 5 + 0.005 |  |  | Gain Potential
Calibration of the PCDN signal on the IC3600 STKK card
Disconnect the 96CD terminals in LCTB2 | 1.
Inject volts at D3 from D2 at the values in the table; also inject mV until the Temp control lamp lights, noting the output at D4 & Acom, and achieve the following table | 2.
ADJ | AFTER ADJ | BEFOR ADJ | STKK O/P PCDN at PIN 13 | PCD sensing | 
Offset R66 |  |  | 1.2 | 3.38 | BREAK Point
R67 |  |  | 3.4 | 4.29 | Setting point
Calibration of the base load signal
Connect a digital voltmeter to Pin 9 of the STKK card at (G01R02) Acom, (D03R04), then connect D2 to D3 to inject and measure the voltage representing the compressor pressure | 1.
Connect an mV source from C4,5 to +1N, -1N; also measure the output of this mV with another digital voltmeter from out & A com on the front of the switches, and this voltage can be measured from D4 & Acom; this reading is the voltage representing the temperature, and the temperature can be obtained as follows: | 2.
Temperature in Fahrenheit = (200) × voltage reading from (D4, Acom) | 
Make Max. VCE by connecting (D10Y & A com). | 3.
Inject volts at D3 from D2 at the values in the table; also inject mV until the Temp control lamp lights, noting the output at D4 & Acom, and achieve the following table: | 4.

Leave the connections as they are | 5.
Calibration of the peak load signal
Use the same previous connections as in the Base signal | 1.
Raise the Temp. Control limit by placing Logic (0) on Pin (3) in the SPOA card. | 2.
Inject volts at D3 from D2 (PCD Pressure) at the values in the table; also inject mV until the Temp control lamp lights, noting the drop in the VCE value and noting the output at D4 & Acom, and achieve the following table: | 3.

uncertain_terms.note: Source spells the meter 'Fluk 187' (presumably Fluke 187); kept verbatim as in the source.
Source 'يرفض' (literally 'refuses') is garbled OCR for 'OFF'; rendered as 'switch OFF all the switches'.
The mV formula in step 3 is garbled in the source ('عامل التصحيح @ 1.02 بالسيارات'); rendered literally as far as readable, with 'بالسيارات' dropped as OCR noise. The formula as printed is suspect.
Source 'الترموتر' rendered as 'thermometer' (inserted in the back of the card for 15 minutes, i.e. for cold-junction stabilisation).
Source input values read '15.18 1.02' etc. with no operator between the two numbers; kept verbatim.
Source header 'PCD الاستشعار (الخامس)' rendered as 'PCD sensing'; '(الخامس)' is unexplained OCR noise.
Source 'Gain Potential' kept verbatim; evidently 'Gain Potentiometer'.
Source temperature rows read '523 C' etc. while the sub-header reads 'م.ف' (Fahrenheit); the unit is ambiguous and was kept as printed ('523 C').
Source thermometer range reads '(F 0 212)'; rendered as '(0–212 °F)'.
Source 'كارت سبوا' rendered as 'SPOA card' by analogy with 'SPOA PK R114' in the peak-load table.
